moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Is Back!
moments.blurb: Ant and Dec return to the Australian jungle as 'I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here!' kicks off its 26th series on Monday, November 16th at 9pm on ITV1.

angles.name: Jungle countdown
angles.copy: Get ready for Bushtucker Trials and celebrity drama! I'm A Celeb is back on Monday for its 26th series. Who are you hoping to see in the jungle this year?

angles.name: Monday night plans
angles.copy: Clear your diary! Ant & Dec are back on our screens next Monday as 'I'm A Celebrity...' launches. The countdown to King/Queen of the Jungle is officially on!

moments.title: Strictly Heads Towards Blackpool
moments.blurb: Following Bethany Antonia's elimination, the remaining couples in 'Strictly Come Dancing' 2026 prepare for Week 8, airing Saturday, November 14th at 6:25pm on BBC One.

moments.title: Jamie Miller Tops UK Chart Again
moments.blurb: Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' holds the UK Official Singles Chart No. 1 spot for an impressive 11th week, while Queens of the Stone Age's 'Perfecth' is the new No. 1 album.

angles.name: Chart domination
angles.copy: Still at number one! Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' reigns supreme for an 11th week on the UK Singles Chart. What's your favourite track from the current Top 40?

angles.name: Album chart topper
angles.copy: New album chart king! Queens of the Stone Age storm to No.1 with 'Perfecth'. What's your verdict on the new rock anthem?

moments.title: Remembrance Day Commemorations
moments.blurb: The UK will observe Remembrance Day tomorrow, November 11th, with the National Service of Remembrance taking place at the Cenotaph in Whitehall, London.

angles.name: Lest we forget
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the nation pauses for Remembrance Day. Join us in remembering and honouring those who have served and sacrificed. #RemembranceDay

angles.name: Cenotaph service
angles.copy: The National Service of Remembrance takes place at the Cenotaph tomorrow. A moment to reflect and remember.

moments.title: EFG London Jazz Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The EFG London Jazz Festival begins on Friday, November 13th, featuring a diverse lineup of world-class artists and emerging talent across various venues in the capital until November 22nd.

angles.copy: London's about to get jazzy! The EFG London Jazz Festival starts Friday, bringing 10 days of incredible music to the capital. Who are you hoping to catch?

angles.name: Music festival vibes
angles.copy: From Goldie to Ben Folds, the EFG London Jazz Festival promises an eclectic mix of sounds. Get ready for world-class performances from November 13th!

moments.title: Cheltenham November Meeting
moments.blurb: The prestigious Cheltenham November Meeting runs from Friday 13th to Sunday 15th November 2026, with the Paddy Power Gold Cup as the feature race on Saturday 14th.

angles.name: Horse racing weekend
angles.copy: It's almost time for the Cheltenham November Meeting! Three days of thrilling racing action kick off Friday, culminating in the Paddy Power Gold Cup on Saturday.

angles.name: Sporting highlight
angles.copy: Get ready for a classic! The Cheltenham November Meeting is a highlight of the National Hunt season, starting this Friday.

moments.title: England vs Croatia at Wembley
